mapper.select: SELECT , p.title AS policy_title, p.category, u.name AS applicant_name, u.phone AS applicant_phone FROM subsidy_apply a LEFT JOIN subsidy_policy p ON p.id = a.policy_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE subsidy_apply SET material_data = #{materialData,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, material_urls = #{materialUrls,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE subsidy_apply SET status = #{status}, disburse_amount = #{disburseAmount}, disburse_by = #{disburseBy}, disburse_at = #{disburseAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
